workarounds.symptom: Saved plans: --flag=FILE skips side-input fingerprints and can overwrite the source
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Bind parsed side inputs in saved plans. Target files: scripts/_common/emit.py, scripts/_common/probe.py, scripts/_common/runner.py. . Saved plans register the media, text and JSON files the tools actually read, regardless of whether the caller writes `--flag FILE` or `--flag=FILE`. Those files are fingerprinted for replay and protected from a plan written to the same path. A value such as a title stays text even if it looks like an existing path. (Ref: https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/pull/601)
